name: Spotify (Spicetify)
reload: cfg="${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/spicetify/config-xpui.ini"; sp="$(awk -F= '/^[[:space:]]*spotify_path[[:space:]]*=/{gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", $2); print $2; exit}' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)"; sp="${sp/#\~/$HOME}"; ver="$(awk -F= '/^[[:space:]]*version[[:space:]]*=/{gsub(/^[[:space:]]+|[[:space:]]+$/, "", $2); print $2; exit}' "$cfg" 2>/dev/null)"; [ -n "$ver" ] && [ -n "$sp" ] && [ -w "$sp/Apps" ] && spicetify apply -q -n
